paper.abstract_en: We consider the non-Abelian bosonized Thirring model for a semi-simple group $G$ at level $k$, with deformation parameter $λ$. We compute the two-point correlation functions of current and composite current operators to cubic order in $λ$, assuming large values of the quadratic Casimir $c_G$ of the group $G$ in the adjoint representation. From these, we extract the $β$-function and the anomalous dimensions of both the current and composite current operators, showing the absence of an additional critical point of order $\frac{k}{c_G}$ to quartic order in $λ$. At this order, our findings agree with those of Destri and de Vega, but contradict the claim of Dashen and Frishman for the Fermionic non-Abelian Thirring model.
